rationale: Price is currently at 76% of today's range and sitting near the session high after recovering from a $14.12 low, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a steady grind upward but with very low volume on most bars — suggesting momentum may be exhausting rather than accelerating. The broader market is under pressure (SPY -0.73%, VIXY +4.03%), which creates headwinds for a long, while the stock is already well off its low and extended above VWAP ($14.80) and the 9-EMA ($15.13), reducing the risk/reward for a short entry at current levels. With no clear structural setup offering a favorable entry with defined risk, skipping is the appropriate response.
